title: Resolution urging Albany to make City fix flooding it causes
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.2200/A.3079, which would require New York City to mitigate property damage from environmental issues caused by its own acts or omissions. It cites chronic flooding and groundwater problems in Southeast Queens, linked to the City's historical management of groundwater pumping and water infrastructure. The bills would require the City to use infrastructure it owns to provide a clear, objective and quantifiable relief plan to affected residents.
